title: 第9章 有人头铁埋伏749第10章 你一只鹅怎么是元婴大妖
content_zh:
萧逸咳嗽一声，摆出一副公事公办的样子。
“咱们749局，毕竟是官方机构，也是讲究一个流程和规矩的。”
“虽然我们习惯暴力执法，动不动就打打杀杀，但也不是不讲理的。”
萧逸一本正经地解释：“这小子虽然嘴巴臭，态度嚣张，但罪不至死。强买强卖，按规矩，也就罚款加拘留。”
陈邪听懂了。
哦，死罪可免，活罪难逃。
“啧。”
萧逸突然咂了咂嘴，脸上露出一丝惋惜。
“可惜啊。”
他看着地上抖成筛糠的柳冲天，幽幽地叹了口气。
“要是他刚才再硬气一点，骨头再铁一点，我就可以以暴力抗法、威胁公务人员生命安全的罪名，直接把他宰了。”
“到时候报告一交，谁也说不出半个不字。”
周围看热闹的黑袍人，齐刷刷地往后退了好几大步。
每个人心里都冒出一股寒气。
我的妈呀！
749局的人，心都这么黑的吗？
连杀人的理由都想好了，就等着对方往套里钻！
这业务也太熟练了吧！
柳冲天更是吓得浑身哆嗦，牙齿上下打颤，发出“咯咯”的声响。
他刚才……刚才差一点就……

“那现在怎么办？”
陈邪觉得这事儿有点麻烦了。
“就这么放了？”
“放了？”萧逸笑了。
他蹲下身，和善地拍了拍柳冲天那张肿成猪头的脸。
“小子，你不会想不开，打算逃跑吧？”
柳冲天的脑袋摇得跟拨浪鼓一样。
“不不不！不跑！我绝对不跑！”
他现在只想离这两个煞星越远越好。
逃跑？
借他十个胆子他也不敢啊！
“很好。”萧逸满意地点了点头。
他站起身，指了指一个角落。
“去，自己找个角落蹲着。”
萧逸脸上的笑容愈发和善，说出来的话却让柳冲天如坠冰窟。
“我们不会看着你，你可以跑。”
“真的，你随时可以跑。”
“只要你跑，我们就能名正言顺地，就地格杀！”
萧逸伸出右手，在自己脖子前，做了一个干脆利落的抹脖子手势。
“……”

柳冲天哭了。
眼泪鼻涕流了一脸，混着嘴角的血，要多狼狈有多狼狈。
这是人话吗？
这是魔鬼的低语啊！
他哪还敢有半点迟疑，手脚并用地爬到那个角落，抱着膝盖，把头深深地埋了进去，活像一只受了惊的鹌鹑。
content_en:
Xiao Yi coughed and acted businesslike.
"After all, our 749 Bureau is an official organization, and we also pay attention to a process and rules."
"Although we are accustomed to violent law enforcement and beating and killing at every turn, we are not unreasonable."
Xiao Yi explained seriously: "Although this kid has a bad mouth and an arrogant attitude, his crime is not worthy of death. To buy and sell by force, according to the rules, you will be fined and detained."
Chen Xie understood.
Oh, death penalty can be avoided, but living crime cannot be escaped.
"Tsk."
Xiao Yi suddenly smacked his lips, with a trace of regret on his face.
"What a pity."
He looked at Liu Chongtian, who was shaking into chaff on the ground, and sighed quietly.
"If he had been tougher and stronger just now, I could have killed him directly for resisting the law with violence and threatening the lives of public servants."
"When the report is handed in, no one will be able to say no."
The men in black robes watching the excitement all took a few steps back.
There was a chill in everyone's heart.
Oh my god!
Are all the people in Bureau 749 so dark-hearted?
He even thought about the reason for killing, and just waited for the other party to slip into the trap!
You are so skilled in this business!
Liu Chongtian was so frightened that his whole body trembled, and his teeth chattered up and down, making a "gurgling" sound.
He just...just now almost...
"What now?"
Chen Xie felt that this matter was a bit troublesome.
"Just let it go?"
"Let go?" Xiao Yi smiled.
He knelt down and patted Liu Chongtian's swollen pig-headed face kindly.
"Boy, are you thinking about it and planning to run away?"
Liu Chongtian's head shook like a rattle.
"No, no, no! Don't run! I will never run!"
Now he just wants to stay as far away from these two evil stars as possible.
Escape?
He wouldn't dare even if he had ten more courages!
"Very good." Xiao Yi nodded with satisfaction.
He stood up and pointed to a corner.
"Go, find a corner and squat by yourself."
The smile on Xiao Yi's face became more kind, but the words he spoke made Liu Chongtian feel like he had fallen into an ice cave.
"We won't watch you, you can run."
"Really, you can run anytime."
"As long as you run away, we can justifiably kill you on the spot!"
Xiao Yi stretched out his right hand and made a neat gesture of wiping his neck in front of his neck.
"..."
Liu Chongtian cried.
Tears and snot ran all over his face, mixed with the blood at the corner of his mouth, making him feel as embarrassed as he wanted.
Is this human language?
This is the whisper of the devil!
He didn't dare hesitate at all. He crawled to the corner on his hands and knees, hugged his knees, and buried his head deeply, like a frightened quail.
